description: AttemptsRemain(retry_count, max_retries) says whether a failed attempt may be followed by another. retry_count counts the attempts that failed before this one (so this was attempt retry_count + 1); max_retries is the attempt limit, 0 meaning unlimited. Another attempt is allowed when max_retries is 0 or retry_count + 1 < max_retries. A retryable failure with attempts remaining is retried; one without dead-letters; a non-retryable failure fails regardless. A lease expiry counts as a retryable failure (the activity goes back to pending without delay, or dead-letters). Both are non-negative integers.
